talimena-scenic-drive.title: Talimena Scenic Drive
talimena-scenic-drive.slogan: Talihina to Mena · one way, about 178 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Talihina
waypoints.advice: Talihina is where the day begins. Next is Winding Stair Mountain.

waypoints.name: Winding Stair Mountain
waypoints.advice: Winding Stair Mountain comes up 59 km in. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Queen Wilhelmina State Park, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Queen Wilhelmina State Park
waypoints.advice: 119 km in you reach Queen Wilhelmina State Park. Next is Mena.

waypoints.name: Mena
waypoints.advice: Mena closes the day.

sections.advice: Talihina → Winding Stair Mountain climbs about 825 m in 44 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Winding Stair Mountain → Queen Wilhelmina State Park drops about 825 m over 34 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Queen Wilhelmina State Park → Mena is 20 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

talimena-scenic-drive.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Talimena Scenic Drive. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Talihina → Winding Stair Mountain
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 79 km. 825 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Talimena Scenic Drive
scenicChapters.narrative: This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else. 62 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it.

scenicChapters.title: Talimena Scenic Drive
scenicChapters.narrative: For 37 km this is Talimena Scenic Drive, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

talimena-scenic-drive.story: From Talihina it runs 178 km to Mena; allow about 2 h 24 of riding. On the way it passes Winding Stair Mountain and Queen Wilhelmina State Park. The highest point is about 800 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
